texts.zh:
[This.Owner.GetEnvoy][This.Leader.GetName]和我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]连蒙带猜地接受了外星人的文化交流邀请。[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的热烈反应应该是积极的。不久之后，他们发来了表示派对倒计时的象形文字。

[This.Owner.GetEnvoyCap][This.Leader.GetName]正在利用剩余的时间准备并进一步学习我们目前获得的语言样本。
texts.en:
With a little bit of guesswork, [This.Owner.GetEnvoy] [This.Leader.GetName] and our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] accepted the alien cultural exchange invitation. We interpreted the enthusiastic response from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] as positive. Shortly after, they sent pictographs depicting a countdown to the party.

[This.Owner.GetEnvoyCap] [This.Leader.GetName] is using the remaining time to prepare and further study the language samples we have obtained.

label.zh: 这是不可多得的学习机会。
label.en: This is a unique learning opportunity.

tooltips.zh: 我们会为邀请做好准备。
tooltips.en: We will prepare for the invitation.

label.en: This would be a perfect chance to covertly gather intel.

tooltips.zh: 我们同意参会，但会让特使装备上间谍科技。
tooltips.en: We agree, but will equip our envoy with our spy tech.

texts.zh:
在这场持续数天的活动这，[This.ContactCountry.GetName]对营养需求的差异的沮丧显而易见。幸好[This.Owner.GetEnvoy][This.Leader.GetName]还是积极参与到了其他的娱乐活动中，并建立了互相的尊重。

[This.Owner.GetEnvoyCap][This.Leader.GetName]离开时对[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的语言文化获得了基本的了解。值得赞扬的是，他们似乎对这一饮食灾难泰然自若，并为我们提供了许多礼仪手册。虽然乏味，但这些知识应该有助于顺利进行未来的外交互动。
texts.en:
The [This.ContactCountry.GetName]'s disappointment in the difference between our nutritional needs couldn't have been more apparent over the multi-day event. Thankfully [This.Owner.GetEnvoy] [This.Leader.GetName] did their best to take an active part in the entertainment events, and mutual respect was established.

[This.Owner.GetEnvoyCap] [This.Leader.GetName] has left with a decent understanding of the [This.ContactCountry.GetName]'s language and culture. To their credit, they seemed to take this culinary mishap in stride, and have provided us with a number of etiquette manuals. While tedious, this knowledge should help smooth future diplomatic interactions.

label.zh: 理解是外交的基石。
label.en: Understanding is the cornerstone of diplomacy.

label.zh: 结局：渴望连接
label.en: Ending: hungry for connection

note.zh: 因饮食需求不同，对方给予“吃不了食物”好感。
note.en: Opinion: could not eat the food.

texts.zh:
敞开心胸来到这场持续多日的盛会，[This.Owner.GetEnvoy][This.Leader.GetName]参加了音乐、戏剧和舞蹈的表演，并尝试了许多餐饮传统。他们对各种体验的接受得到了[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的热烈欢迎。

离开时，[This.Owner.GetEnvoyCap][This.Leader.GetName]对他们的语言获得了非常深切的理解，对他们的文化也颇为赞赏。这段经历将会为我们未来与[This.ContactCountry.GetName]更加积极正面的外交奠定基础。
texts.en:
Entering the multi-day event with an open mind, [This.Owner.GetEnvoy] [This.Leader.GetName] joined in musical, theater, and dance performances and explored various culinary traditions. Their receptiveness to experience was met enthusiastically by the [This.ContactCountry.GetName].

[This.Owner.GetEnvoyCap] [This.Leader.GetName] has left with an intimate understanding of their language and a deep appreciation of their culture. Their experience will pave the way to more positive diplomatic interactions with the [This.ContactCountry.GetName].

label.zh: 来自新朋友的邀请真是亲切啊。
label.en: A kind invitation from new friends.

note.en: In the game, the name of the other empire appears here.

label.en: Ending: life of the party

note.en: Life-of-the-party opinion.

texts.zh:
[This.Owner.GetEnvoyCap][This.Leader.GetName]在这场持续多日的活动中客气地参观着文艺活动，小试着他们的饮食文化。不温不火的态度让[This.ContactCountry.GetName]颇感沮丧。根据我们对他们语言的理解，他们说我们的特使“很无聊”。

我们的特使被护送回到太空梭上并被示意离开。特使已经掌握了他们的语言，并对他们的文化有了初步的了解，我们可以在未来的外交互动中以此为基础。
texts.en:
[This.Owner.GetEnvoyCap] [This.Leader.GetName] spent the multi-day event reservedly observing artistic shows and sampling the culinary traditions. The lack of enthusiasm frustrated the [This.ContactCountry.GetName]. According to our understanding of their language, our envoy was considered boring.

Escorted back to their shuttle and signaled to leave, our envoy has left with competence in their language and a surface understanding of their culture, something we can build upon for future diplomatic interactions.

label.zh: 特使累了。
label.en: The envoy tried.

note.en: In the game, the name of the other empire appears here.

label.en: Ending: threw in the towel

note.en: Wet-towel opinion.

texts.zh:
[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的活动持续的时间远超预期。

[This.Owner.GetEnvoy][This.Leader.GetName]的太空梭返回时汇报了任务失败。

在活动过程中，主办方找到了谍报装置。[This.Owner.GetEnvoyCap][This.Leader.GetName]遭到了审问和训斥，并被遣返。通过后备间谍科技获取的数据，我们现在理解了他们的语言和科技，然而我们的外交前景一片渺茫。
texts.en:
The [This.ContactCountry.GetName]'s event lasted much longer than expected.

When [This.Owner.GetEnvoy] [This.Leader.GetName]'s shuttle returned, they reported that the operation failed.

During the event, the hosts found an espionage device. [This.Owner.GetEnvoyCap] [This.Leader.GetName] was interrogated, scolded and then asked to leave. Using the data from the back-up spy tech, we now understand their language and technology, although our diplomatic future will start on rocky ground.

label.zh: 真不幸。
label.en: Unfortunate.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这位人物的名字。
note.en: In the game, the character's name appears here.

label.zh: 结局：间谍行动失误
label.en: Ending: espionage blunder

note.zh: 对方给予“被抓到间谍”好感，我方获得 25 点情报。
note.en: Caught-spying opinion; +25 intel.

texts.zh:
[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的活动举办时间远超预期。

乘坐太空梭返回后，[This.Owner.GetEnvoy][This.Leader.GetName]汇报了行动大获成功。不仅这种外星语言被大部分破解了，我们的扫描也揭示了他们科技能力的清晰图景。

这将会极大地促进我们与[This.ContactCountry.GetName]未来的关系，同时还让他们对我们对他们科技了如指掌一事蒙在鼓里。
texts.en:
The [This.ContactCountry.GetName]'s event lasted much longer than expected.

When [This.Owner.GetEnvoy] [This.Leader.GetName]'s shuttle returned, they reported that the operation was a success. Not only did they successfully decipher most of the alien language, but our scan has given us a clear picture of their technological capabilities.

This will greatly enhance further relations with the [This.ContactCountry.GetName], without them being aware of our understanding of their scientific knowledge.

label.zh: 棒极了。
label.en: Excellent.

label.en: Ending: scan complete

note.zh: 获得 50 点情报。
note.en: +50 intel.

texts.zh:
我们对[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的邀请不闻不问冒犯到了他们。他们的态度发生了一百八十度大转弯。在后续的通讯中我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]翻译出了一些敌意性的言辞。

他们似乎不想要我们拒绝。
texts.en:
Our lack of interest in their invitation has offended the [This.ContactCountry.GetName]. Their tone has dramatically changed. Our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] translated some hostile language within their follow-up communication.

It seems they do not want to take no for an answer.

label.zh: 很好很好。我们会出席的。
label.en: Very well. We will attend.

tooltips.zh: 我们终究会为了顺畅的外交关系出席的。
tooltips.en: We will attend, after all, for the sake of smooth diplomatic relations.

label.zh: 不去就是不去。
label.en: The answer is still no.

tooltips.zh: 我们没有任何理由接受这个邀请
tooltips.en: We will in no way accept the invitation.

label.en: Stage: xeno dinner party: refused twice (difficulty 0)

texts.zh:
第二次拒绝[This.ContactCountry.GetName]让我们前往他们的舰船的邀请得到了情绪激烈的回复。我们收到了一份来自多名外星船员长达数个小时的通讯，我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]认为他们似乎是在因我们的不愿出息而发出谴责。

这些通信，加上从他们船上截获的信号，使我们能够破译足够多他们的语言以产生有意义的理解。尽管他们对这一事件持消极态度，但我们现在可以建立更适当的外交关系了。
texts.en:
The second rejection by the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] to invite us to their ship was met with a strong emotional response. We received communication from multiple alien crew members for several hours, in what our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] believe was an attempt to guilt us for not attending.

These communications, along with intercepted signals from their ship, have allowed us to decipher enough of their language to have a working understanding. We can now initiate more appropriate diplomatic connections, although they have taken this initial incident negatively.

label.zh: 这些外星人可真顽固。
label.en: These aliens are persistent.

note.en: In the game, the name of the other empire appears here.

label.zh: 结局：不就是不
label.en: Ending: no means no

note.zh: 两次拒绝，对方给予“双重拒绝”好感。
note.en: “Double rejection” opinion.

summary.text:
# 邀请 / The Invitation（异星晚宴 Xeno Dinner Party）
- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7) · 首次接触阶段链 first-contact stage chain（首个事件「邀请」first_contact.1120）

## 如何开始 How it starts

第二阶段抽取，权重 5；本方有此链标记、为格式塔、灭绝倾向或政策允许攻击则为 0；对方为格式塔，或对方非主动政策且亲异族，也为 0（`common/first_contact/00_first_contact.txt:706–738`）。/ Stage-2 weight 5; zero if the owner had the chain, is gestalt, homicidal or has the attack-allowed policy; zero for gestalt contacts and for non-proactive xenophile contacts.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

1. **邀请（1120）**：对方在边境停泊飞船，邀请我方代表参加为期数日的文化交流。A 接受 / B 拒绝。/ The aliens invite a representative to a multi-day cultural exchange; A accepts, B refuses.
